HH24:MI') as regDt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_REPLIES r WHERE r.POST_ID = p.POST_ID AND NVL(r.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N') as replyCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ATTACHMENTS a WHERE a.POST_ID = p.POST_ID) as fileCount, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ATTACHMENTS a WHERE a.POST_ID = p.POST_ID) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as hasFile, REGEXP_COUNT(NVL(p.CONTENT, ' '), '<[[:space:]]*img([[:space:]>])', 1, 'i') as imageCount, REGEXP_COUNT(NVL(p.CONTENT, ' '), '<[[:space:]]*(svg|canvas)([[:space:]>])', 1, 'i') as drawingCount, REGEXP_COUNT(NVL(p.CONTENT, ' '), '<[[:space:]]*(video|iframe|oembed)([[:space:]>])', 1, 'i') as videoCount, REGEXP_COUNT(NVL(p.CONTENT, ' '), '<[[:space:]]*a([[:space:]>])', 1, 'i') as linkCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ATTACHMENTS a WHERE a.POST_ID = p.POST_ID) as documentCount, cr.REACTION_TYPE = 'LIKE') as likeCount FROM BOARD_POSTS p LEFT JOIN BOARD_CHANNELS c ON c.CHANNEL_ID = p.CHANNEL_ID JOIN USERS u ON p.USER_ID = u.USER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT USER_ID, ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, CROPPED_IMAGE_PATH FROM ( SELECT pi.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pi.USER_ID ORDER BY CASE WHEN pi.IS_CURRENT='Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, pi.CREATED_AT DESC, pi.PROFILE_IMAGE_ID mapper.sql: SELECT br.REPORT_ID, br.CONTENT_TYPE, br.CONTENT_ID, br.REPORTER_ID, reporter.USER_NAME AS REPORTER_NAME, br.REASON, br.DETAIL, br.STATUS, TO_CHAR(br.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS REG_DT, TO_CHAR(br.PROC_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS PROC_DT, procUser.USER_NAME AS PROC_USER_NAME, CASE WHEN br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' THEN replyPost.POST_ID ELSE post.POST_ID END AS POST_ID, CASE WHEN br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' THEN replyPost.WS_ID ELSE post.WS_ID END AS WS_ID, CASE WHEN br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' THEN replyPost.PROJ_ID ELSE post.PROJ_ID END AS PROJ_ID, CASE WHEN br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' THEN replyPost.BOARD_TYPE ELSE post.BOARD_TYPE END AS BOARD_TYPE, CASE WHEN br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' THEN replyPost.TITLE ELSE post.TITLE END AS TARGET_TITLE, CASE WHEN br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(reply.CONTENT, '<[^>]*>', '') ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(post.CONTENT, 1000, 1), '<[^>]*>', '') END AS TARGET_CONTENT, CASE WHEN br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' THEN reply.REPLY_ID ELSE NULL END AS REPLY_ID, CASE WHEN br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' THEN NVL(reply.DELETED_YN, 'N') ELSE NVL(post.DELETED_YN, 'N') END AS TARGET_DELETED_YN, CASE WHEN br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' THEN reply.DELETED_BY ELSE post.DELETED_BY END AS TARGET_DELETED_BY, TO_CHAR(CASE WHEN br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' THEN reply.DELETED_AT ELSE post.DELETED_AT END, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS TARGET_DELETED_AT, targetUser.USER_NAME AS TARGET_WRITER_NAME FROM BOARD_REPORTS br JOIN USERS reporter ON reporter.USER_ID = br.REPORTER_ID LEFT JOIN USERS procUser ON procUser.USER_ID = br.PROC_USER_ID LEFT JOIN BOARD_POSTS post ON br.CONTENT_TYPE IN ('BOARD', 'NOTICE', 'FILE') AND post.POST_ID = br.CONTENT_ID LEFT JOIN BOARD_REPLIES reply ON br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' AND reply.REPLY_ID = br.CONTENT_ID LEFT JOIN BOARD_POSTS replyPost ON reply.POST_ID = replyPost.POST_ID LEFT JOIN USERS targetUser ON targetUser.USER_ID = CASE WHEN br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' THEN reply.USER_ID ELSE post.USER_ID END

sql.if: AND ( UPPER(NVL(CASE WHEN br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' THEN replyPost.TITLE ELSE post.TITLE END, '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(NVL(reporter.USER_NAME, '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(NVL(targetUser.USER_NAME, '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(NVL(br.REASON, '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(NVL(br.DETAIL, '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR (br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' AND UPPER(NVL(reply.CONTENT, '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%') OR (br.CONTENT_TYPE != 'REPLY' AND UPPER(NVL(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(post.CONTENT, 1000, 1), '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%') )

SELECT p.POST_ID as postId, p.WS_ID as wsId, p.PROJ_ID as projId, p.CHANNEL_ID as channelId, c.CHANNEL_NAME as channelName, c.CHANNEL_TYPE as channelType, p.TITLE as title, p.USER_ID as userId, CASE WHEN NVL(wmp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN NVL(wmp.DISPLAY_NAME, u.USER_NAME) ELSE u.USER_NAME END as writerName, CASE WHEN NVL(wmp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN CASE WHEN (wmp.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH IS NOT NULL OR wmp.PROFILE_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_PATH IS NOT NULL) AND NOT (UPPER(NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT')) = 'DEFAULT' AND NVL(wmp.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, '#') = NVL(u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, '#') AND NVL(wmp.PROFILE_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_PATH, '#') = NVL(u.PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, '#')) THEN NVL(wmp.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, wmp.PROFILE_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_PATH) END WHEN UPPER(NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT')) <> 'DEFAULT' THEN NVL(u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, NVL(upi.CROPPED_IMAGE_PATH, NVL(u.PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, upi.ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH))) ELSE NULL END AS "writerProfileImagePath", CASE WHEN NVL(wmp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN CASE WHEN (wmp.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH IS NOT NULL OR wmp.PROFILE_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_PATH IS NOT NULL) AND NOT (UPPER(NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT')) = 'DEFAULT' AND NVL(wmp.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, '#') = NVL(u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, '#') AND NVL(wmp.PROFILE_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_PATH, '#') = NVL(u.PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, '#')) THEN 'IMAGE' ELSE 'DEFAULT' END WHEN UPPER(NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT')) = 'DEFAULT' THEN 'DEFAULT' WHEN NVL(u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, upi.CROPPED_IMAGE_PATH) IS NOT NULL OR NVL(u.PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, upi.ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH) IS NOT NULL THEN 'IMAGE' ELSE UPPER(NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT')) END AS "writerProfileAvatarType", p.VIEW_COUNT as viewCount, p.BOARD_TYPE as boardType, CASE WHEN p.IS_PINNED='Y' AND (p.PIN_START_DT IS NULL OR p.PIN_START_DT <= SYSDATE) AND (p.PIN_END_DT IS NULL OR p.PIN_END_DT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END as isPinned, TO_CHAR(p.PIN_START_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD') as pinStartDt, TO_CHAR(p.PIN_END_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD') as pinEndDt, CASE WHEN TRUNC(p.REG_DT)=TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN TO_CHAR(p.REG_DT,'HH24:MI') ELSE TO_CHAR(p.REG_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD') END as regDt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_REPLIES r WHERE r.POST_ID=p.POST_ID AND NVL(r.DELETED_YN,'N')='N') as replyCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ATTACHMENTS a WHERE a.POST_ID=p.POST_ID) as fileCount, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ATTACHMENTS a WHERE a.POST_ID=p.POST_ID) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as hasFile, /* 게시글 메타는 "어디에 넣었는지"를 기준으로 구분한다. - 에디터 본문에 삽입한 이미지는 사진 - SVG/Canvas는 그림 - 에디터 본문에 삽입한 영상은 영상 - 본문 링크는 링크 - 첨부 영역으로 올린 자료는 확장자와 무관하게 파일 */ REGEXP_COUNT(NVL(p.CONTENT, ' '), '<[[:space:]]*img([[:space:]>])', 1, 'i') as imageCount, REGEXP_COUNT(NVL(p.CONTENT, ' '), '<[[:space:]]*(svg|canvas)([[:space:]>])', 1, 'i') as drawingCount, REGEXP_COUNT(NVL(p.CONTENT, ' '), '<[[:space:]]*(video|iframe|oembed)([[:space:]>])', 1, 'i') as videoCount, REGEXP_COUNT(NVL(p.CONTENT, ' '), '<[[:space:]]*a([[:space:]>])', 1, 'i') as linkCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ATTACHMENTS a WHERE a.POST_ID=p.POST_ID) as documentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONTENT_REACTIONS cr WHERE cr.CONTENT_ID=p.POST_ID AND cr.CONTENT_TYPE=CASE WHEN c.CHANNEL_TYPE='NOTICE' THEN 'NOTICE' ELSE 'BOARD' END AND cr.REACTION_TYPE='LIKE') as likeCount FROM BOARD_POSTS p JOIN BOARD_CHANNELS c ON c.CHANNEL_ID=p.CHANNEL_ID AND c.DELETED_YN='N' JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID=p.USER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT USER_ID, ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, CROPPED_IMAGE_PATH FROM ( SELECT pi.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY pi.USER_ID ORDER BY CASE WHEN pi.IS_CURRENT = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, pi.CREATED_AT DESC, pi.PROFILE_IMAGE_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM USER_PROFILE_IMAGES pi ) WHERE RN = 1 ) upi ON upi.USER_ID = u.USER_ID LEFT JOIN PROJECTS pr ON pr.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID LEFT JOIN WS_MEMBER_PROFILES wmp ON wmp.WS_ID=CASE WHEN p.PROJ_ID IS NOT NULL THEN pr.WS_ID ELSE p.WS_ID END AND wmp.USER_ID=p.USER_ID WHERE p.CHANNEL_ID=#{channelId} AND NVL(p.DELETED_YN,'N')='N'
AND UPPER(p.TITLE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' AND UPPER(p.CONTENT) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' AND UPPER(CASE WHEN NVL(wmp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE,'Y')='N' THEN NVL(wmp.DISPLAY_NAME,u.USER_NAME) ELSE u.USER_NAME END) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
AND (UPPER(p.TITLE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(p.CONTENT) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(CASE WHEN NVL(wmp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE,'Y')='N' THEN NVL(wmp.DISPLAY_NAME,u.USER_NAME) ELSE u.USER_NAME END) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%')
ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.IS_PINNED='Y' AND (p.PIN_START_DT IS NULL OR p.PIN_START_DT <= SYSDATE) AND (p.PIN_END_DT IS NULL OR p.PIN_END_DT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.REG_DT DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
